warning.titlePre: Mercedes R320 CDI Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your R320 CDI is a 2006–2013 model with the OM642 diesel V6 — that's the W251/V251 generation — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
